plan: FICTIONAL EVALUATION FIXTURE. I have an eight-year-old cat who has always lived alone and I want to adopt a kitten. I live in a one-bedroom apartment and work from home. I can afford routine care for both cats. I plan to adopt the kitten two weeks before a ten-day holiday, during which a friend will visit once a day.

assignment.objective: How introducing a kitten to a solitary adult cat interacts with the short window before departure.
questions: How far along is the introduction likely to be by departure?

findings.title: Introduction may still be in progress at departure
findings.observation: If the introduction is still at an early stage after two weeks, the cats would be left mostly unsupervised before their relationship has stabilized.
findings.why_it_matters: Unsupervised conflict or stress is harder to prevent or notice during the trip.
assumptions: The introduction will not be complete within two weeks
findings.question_to_check: How settled do you expect the cats to be by the day you leave?

findings.title: Separation fallback depends on unstated space
findings.observation: If the cats need to be kept apart during the trip, a one-bedroom apartment may or may not offer a closable space with separate resources; the plan does not say.
findings.why_it_matters: Without a workable separation option, there is no fallback if the cats are not ready to share space.
assumptions: The apartment has limited closable spaces
The introduction may not be complete by departure
findings.question_to_check: What space could you use to keep the cats apart while you are away?

assignment.objective: Whether one daily visit covers the care of two cats, one newly adopted, for ten days.
questions: What does the daily visit need to cover?

findings.title: Once-daily visit may undercount kitten care
findings.observation: Depending on its age, a kitten may need more frequent feeding and monitoring than one daily visit provides.
findings.why_it_matters: Care sized for one adult cat may not cover a young kitten's needs.
assumptions: The kitten is young enough that its care needs differ from an adult cat's
findings.question_to_check: How old will the kitten be when you leave, and what care will it need each day?

findings.title: No stated plan for problems between visits
findings.observation: The plan does not describe how a problem arising between visits (illness, injury, conflict) would be noticed or handled.
findings.why_it_matters: A problem could go unaddressed for up to a day.
assumptions: The friend is not present beyond the daily visit
findings.question_to_check: What should happen if a problem starts between visits?

assignment.objective: Health considerations of introducing a kitten shortly before reduced supervision.
questions: Where is the kitten in its health schedule?

findings.title: Vaccination schedule versus departure date
findings.observation: If the kitten's vaccinations are incomplete, a follow-up dose could fall due while you are away, depending on the dates involved.
findings.why_it_matters: A missed or delayed dose, or illness while only a visitor is present, would be harder to manage.
assumptions: The kitten's vaccination schedule is not complete at adoption
findings.question_to_check: When are the kitten's next vaccinations due relative to your trip?

findings.title: Visitor's ability to respond to emergencies
findings.observation: A once-daily visitor may not recognize a developing problem or know what they are allowed to do about it.
findings.why_it_matters: A fast-developing problem could worsen before anyone acts.
assumptions: The friend has not been given monitoring guidance or authority to act
findings.question_to_check: What has your friend been told to watch for, and what may they decide on your behalf?

e2-f1.title: Once-daily visit may undercount kitten care

questions.question: How old is the kitten, and which vaccinations has it had?
questions.why_it_matters: The answer affects how much daily care the kitten needs and whether health follow-up could fall during the trip.

questions.question: If the cats are not comfortable together by departure, what space would you use to keep them apart?
questions.why_it_matters: A workable separation setup is the fallback if the introduction is not complete.

questions.question: What has your friend been told to watch for, and what are they allowed to decide about the cats' care?
questions.why_it_matters: This determines whether problems would be noticed and acted on during the once-daily visits.
